attempts.text:
**The window starts on a spine.** Column 0, `ycjF`, a TIGR01620 family protein, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names it in 99% of calls, with 0.03 bits.

**Then the graph opens for 79 columns.** Columns 1 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 87% of calls, named in 75 to 100%. The model names 93% of genes across the window, 0.37 bits on average. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.77 against 0.21 bits, and names fewer genes, 85% against 96%.

**A first branch runs through columns 1 to 24**, 24 families from `tyrR` to `uspF`, 18 persistent and 6 shell, each carried by 10 to 13% of chromosomes. The most carried families there are the `ycj` forks, `ycjX` to `ycjM`, then the `psp` operon, [[envelope stress response]], and the `puu` genes, [[putrescine catabolism]]. A second branch of 5 families, `eefD` to `eefR`, [[efflux transport]], runs through columns 34 to 38, carried by 24 to 25% of chromosomes.

**The middle is largely persistent.** Columns 28 to 33, `ymjA` to `sapF`, [[peptide transport]], are carried by 86 to 87% of chromosomes; columns 39 to 53, `pdeR` to `ymiA`, by 84 to 86%; columns 55 to 74, `topA` to `yciC`, by 72 to 86%, including the `trp` genes, [[tryptophan biosynthesis]]. A third branch, `cls` to `oppC`, [[peptide transport]], runs through columns 75 to 79, carried by 14 to 23% of chromosomes.

**The window ends hesitantly.** The most hesitant columns are column 78, `yciI`, 0.95 bits and in a region of plasticity in 26% of calls; column 79, `kch`, 0.92 bits and 28%; column 77, `tonB`, 0.82 bits and 24%. The model names the fewest genes at column 78, 75%. The window ends at column 79, `kch`, in 49% of chromosomes.

label: ycjF
facts:
WINDOW: the ycjF window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ycjF, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,360 to 2,439 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ycjF once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.37 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 28,367 calls, named 98%, 0.17 bits; shell 14,258 calls, named 87%, 0.63 bits; cloud 415 calls, named 3%, 4.86 bits. Outside an RGP 30,813 calls, named 96%, 0.21 bits; inside an RGP 12,227 calls, named 85%, 0.77 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 37 fork, 42 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.77 against 0.21 bits) and names fewer genes (85% against 96%); 12,227 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 78 (yciI) 0.95 bits, RGP 26%; column 79 (kch) 0.92 bits, RGP 28%; column 77 (tonB) 0.82 bits, RGP 24%. The 20 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 95%, 0.34 bits on average; the other 60 columns: named 93%, 0.38 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0-87%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: ycjF "TIGR01620 family protein". named 99%; 0.03 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0-87%. named 75-100% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 78, named 75%, 0.95 bits.
   a second branch of 24 families through columns 1-24, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10-13%, 18 P, 6 S; the branch's families: tyrR, tpx, ycjG, mpaA, ycjY, pgrR, mppA, ynaI, ynaJ, uspE, fnr, ogt, abgT, abgB, abgA, abgR, smrA, dgcM, ydaN, zntB, ynaL, dbpA, ttcA, uspF

   a second branch of 5 families through columns 75-79, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 14-23%, all P; the branch's families: cls, yciU, oppF, oppD, oppC
